verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a CLI built for IT admins to automate installation and configuration across many devices through software deployment tools. Its example batch script installs the client, registers the license key and sets a password, and custom preconfigured clients can be generated in my.anydesk. missing for 10: explicit MSI package or MDM deployment evidence, an explicit silent flag for install (--silent is only shown for removal), independent or hands-on corroboration of fleet rollout.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can mass-deploy the client with preset configuration through MSI, MDM, or a documented silent install

citations.quote: You can use CLI commands with software deployment tools to install and configure AnyDesk on multiple devices, without manual setup on each machine.
The following example batch script installs AnyDesk, registers the license key, and sets a password
The AnyDesk Command-Line Interface (CLI) allows advanced users and IT administrators to automate installation, configuration, connection, and removal tasks.
